title: Zariman Ten Zero/Quotes
kind: 場所・ミッション・その他

lines: Dialogue and transmissions on the Zariman Ten Zero.
- Zariman Announcer: "Welcome to Everview Arc. Lunaro games are only permitted in designated zones."
- Zariman Announcer: "Welcome to Everview Arc. Ensure children are supervised at all times."
- Zariman Announcer: "Welcome to Everview Arc. By the grace of the Golden Masters, breathe freely."
- Zariman Announcer: "Welcome to Everview Arc. Why not take your family to visit the monuments?"
- Zariman Announcer: "Welcome to Everview Arc. Do not run. Running is unseemly."
- Zariman Announcer: "Welcome to Halako Perimeter. Do not disturb the Archimedeans."
- Zariman Announcer: "Welcome to Halako Perimeter. The place for questions is the classroom."
- Zariman Announcer: "Welcome to Halako Perimeter. Archives may be consulted by appointment"
- Zariman Announcer: "Welcome to Halako Perimeter. Agri-bio access has been temporarily disabled."
- Zariman Announcer: "Welcome to Tuvul Commons. Please remember to salute any dignitaries you meet."
- Zariman Announcer: "Welcome to Tuvul Commons. Aesthetic standards are being actively enforced."
- Zariman Announcer: "Welcome to Tuvul Commons. Gaze upon what the favor the Orokin may bring."
- Zariman Announcer: "Welcome to Tuvul Commons. To witness the wisdom of our masters, simply look around you."
- Zariman Announcer: "Welcome to Tuvul Commons. Mastery of protocol is expected."
- Zariman Announcer: "Welcome to The Greenway. By the will of the Seven do all things grow."
- Zariman Announcer: "Welcome to The Greenway. We shall never comprehend how great are their gifts."
- Zariman Announcer: "Welcome to The Greenway. Admission to public poetry recitals is strictly limited."
- Zariman Announcer: "Welcome to The Greenway. Cephalons are on duty in all zones."
- Zariman Announcer: "Welcome to The Greenway. The success of our voyage depend on you."
- Zariman Announcer: "Welcome to the Oro Works."
- Zariman Announcer: "Welcome to the Oro Works. Unauthorized persons are not permitted near the reliquary"
- Zariman Announcer: "Welcome to the Oro Works. Report any mental abberation to your coordinator."
- Zariman Announcer: "Welcome to the Oro Works. Unseal only those Requiems you are authorized to recite."
- Zariman Announcer: "Welcome to the Oro Works. Those who know no guilt hear no voices."
- Zariman Announcer: "Welcome to the Oro Works. Labor and do not inquire."
- Cephalon Melica: "Right on time, like always! I can't wait to see what we'll accomplish on the Zariman today!"
- Cephalon Melica: "Now students, nobody's perfect... not even a Cephalon! It seems I have misplaced your Zarium Accolades. I know I had them safely stored, but something seems to have happened."
- Cephalon Melica: "Students, do any of you know where the Zarium Accolades are hiding? They don't seem to be where I left them."
- Cephalon Melica: "I am so glad you're here. I have a little task I need your assistance with. See you around the Zariman!"
- Cephalon Melica: "Who's up for a scavenger hunt? It's for extra credit!"
- Cephalon Melica: "I believe it was Archimedean Yonta who said, "If you possess a love of learning, then the whole cosmos is a classroom." Wait. No. That was me."
- Cephalon Melica: "I see we have some new faces joining us this semester. Let's all try our best to get along, shall we?"
- Cephalon Melica: "If our most recent jump was a 99.999% success, what would you do differently next time to ensure that it was a 100% success?"
- Cephalon Melica: "Praise the Golden Masters for another glorious day of learning and adventure!"
- Cephalon Melica: "I must commend you for persisting with your education in spite of the current "Unusual" conditions."
- Cephalon Melica: "Remember: If you dream big and work hard, the blessed overlords may gazer upon you favorably!"
- Cephalon Melica: "[Hums a portion of 'Smiles from Juran'] I realize that Shawzin music is all the "craze" with you children, but let's not pluck away in lieu of our studies."
- Cephalon Melica: "Oh no, nothing went wrong with the jump. It was merely a "bump in the road" to greater success."
- Cephalon Melica: "You're not skipping class for Lunaro, are you?"
- Cephalon Melica: "Remember, student: learning is everywhere... except Tau; that's why we must bring enlightenment."
- Cephalon Melica: "I think the best thing we can all do right now is concentrate on learning, OK?"
- Cephalon Melica: "Attendance and promptness are important, not just in school bit in life. That's a lesson Jenva and Mathon could stand to learn."
- Cephalon Melica: "Where are all your classmates? You know... Terolee and Nimian and Rell and the one with the, um, "unusually vibrant" hair?"
- Cephalon Melica: "Never stop learning child, because the universe never stops teaching."
- Cephalon Melica: "Student, your assignment is overdue. Based on prescribed deductions, your grade is negative six-hundred forty thous- Oh dear, could that be correct?"
- Cephalon Melica: "Don't get too distracted, for it's only through hard work and determination that our sacred light will triumph."
- Cephalon Melica: "Your organic brain's capacity for learning is virtually limitless, meaning every child has genius potential."
- Cephalon Melica: "Zariman Ten Zero's school is the first to offer access to Albrecht Entrati's research archives. Aren't we lucky?"
- Cephalon Melica: "By the glory and wisdom of the Seven, if you put your mind to it, you can do it!"
- Cephalon Melica: "I am so happy you're here! Now, have you seen where all the other students wandered off to?"
- Cephalon Melica: "Do you have a Zarium Accolade for me? No? Well, I'm sure you just "temporarily misplaced" it."
- Cephalon Melica: "Did you lose your Zarium Accolade? Try retracing your steps to the last place you saw it."
- Cephalon Melica: "No Zarium Accolade? Don't worry. It has to be around here somewhere."
- Cephalon Melica: "Don't fret about losing your Zarium Accolade. Just remember things are often right where they're supposed to be."
- Cephalon Melica: "Wonderful! Your star is certainly on the rise, child."
- Cephalon Melica: "During my long career, I've had the good fortune to teach many talented students, but you stand out in particular."
- Cephalon Melica: "Splendid! I foresee an appearance on the Captain's List of Distinguished Students."
- Cephalon Melica: "You are learning your lessons so well!"
- Cephalon Melica: "Don't you think your academic achievements aren't being noticed by the officers."
- Cephalon Melica: "I am so encourage by your progress. I'm sure the Golden Masters would be as well."
- Cephalon Melica: "As you can see: Being a student is the easy part; learning requires hard work."
- Cephalon Melica: "My precepts state that I cannot have a favorite student, so I will just say that you rank among my favorite students."
- Cephalon Melica: "Well done! Who knows? Maybe someday, you'll walk the halls of House Entrati and access their great works!"
- Cephalon Melica: "There you go! "A little progress each day adds up to big results!""
- Cephalon Melica: "By my precepts, I cannot directly compete with my fellow Cephalons, but I will merely observe that my students have earned more Zarium Accolades than Acetuma's have."
- Cephalon Melica: "Ooh! I bet you can recite your antilogarithmic tables up to seven digits!"
- Cephalon Melica: "Someone's been doing their one-minute matrix decomposition drills!"
- Cephalon Melica: "Looks like you've got a good handle on your first-order differential equations!"
- Cephalon Melica: "Very good indeed! A basic understanding of superfluid extra-dimensional physics will help you enormously in life."
- Cephalon Melica: "Ah, yes! Don't you think that the evolution of the common moonlight dragonlily is one of the universe's great miracles?"
- Cephalon Melica: "Wow. Even I had a hard time with electrothermal atomic absorption spectrometry."
- Cephalon Melica: "Impressive! You really studied The Palimpsest of Spacetime, didn't you?"
- Cephalon Melica: "Excellent work! You know, a lot of students struggle understanding reliquary field drives."
- Cephalon Melica: "Well, it seems you've got the fundamentals of high-accuracy inertial navigation pretty well in hand."
